62/S0.subgoal: Explain how scripting provides a customized experience in the Unity development environment using C# components.

62/S1.subgoal: Describe how to create and place script files in the Unity editor.

62/S2.subgoal: Explain the structure and key components of a C# script file in Unity.

62/S3.subgoal: Explain prebuilt and user-defined functions, particularly event-driven functions.

62/S4.subgoal: Describe how to instantiate prefabs at runtime.

62/S5.subgoal: Describe standard programming constructs like conditionals and loops in Unity.

62/S6.subgoal: Explain how to manipulate an object's transform property through scripting.

62/S7.subgoal: Explain the concept and usage of coroutines for frame-based operations.

62/S8.subgoal: Describe how to use InvokeRepeating to call methods periodically.

62/S9.subgoal: Explain how Unity handles user interaction and various input types.

62/S10.subgoal: Describe how to use the build settings to deploy a system to a specified platform.

62/S11.subgoal: Explain the necessity and process of integrating external SDKs into Unity.

62/S12.subgoal: Describe the features of the Vuforia SDK and its initial setup.

62/S13.subgoal: Explain how to create and import a Vuforia database and image targets.

62/S14.subgoal: Describe how to configure a Vuforia project with models and settings.

62/S15.subgoal: Explain how to build and deploy a Vuforia-based AR project on an Android platform.

62/S16.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts for relating theory to practice in Unity.
